name: Five Fine-Grained Image Benchmark Datasets
description: A collection/summary of five fine-grained image benchmark datasets intended for evaluating fine-grained visual categorization.
evaluation_method: top-1 accuracy (sometimes complemented by top-5 accuracy)
typical_sota_score: 80–98% (varies by dataset; some datasets are near-saturated while others remain challenging)
reputation: These datasets are standard benchmarks in the fine-grained visual categorization community and are widely used to evaluate specialized recognition methods.
notes: Individual datasets are often small and class-imbalanced; performance can depend heavily on localization/part-based modeling. Some sets are approaching saturation for specialized architectures; potential domain bias and limited diversity.
